patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description: Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches.name: Access Points menu style
patches.description: Switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description: Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description: Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation, and separately enable automatic punctuation for Traditional Chinese voice typing, which does not support Advanced Voice Typing.

patches.name: Backup & Restore
patches.description: Export or restore all Patches settings, and back up, compare, or restore the Gboard PB/XML flag store.

patches.name: Change emoji size
patches.description: Change emoji size.

patches.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches.description: Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item.

patches.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches.description: Enhance clipboard retention time, item count limit, preview lines, countdown/creation time labels, order index, and column count.

patches.name: Close Proactive Suggestions
patches.description: Show a dismiss button in the proactive suggestions bar.

patches.name: Custom Symbols
patches.description: Add a dedicated custom symbols tab and replace the long-press comma entry with a heart shortcut.

patches.name: Developer options
patches.description: Enable Developer options and the Flag Editor, allowing you to modify flag values.

patches.name: Emojis, stickers & GIFs Tab Order
patches.description: Customize the bottom tab order in Gboard's Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel with drag-and-drop reordering.

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches.description: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions

patches.name: Enable OCR / Scan Text
patches.description: Enable the OCR / Scan Text feature with Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari recognition backends.

patches.name: Enable accessibility layout
patches.description: Enable accessibility layout.

patches.name: Enable cursor trackpad mode
patches.description: Long-press the space bar to use cursor trackpad and lock modes.

patches.name: Enable split keyboard
patches.description: Enable the split keyboard layout.

patches.name: English QWERTY Up-Flick Uppercase
patches.description: Flick up on the English QWERTY keyboard to toggle uppercase and lowercase.

patches.name: FTP Server
patches.description: Add a LAN FTP server with file browsing, transfers, and download resume.

patches.name: Floating Web Search
patches.description: Open a floating web page directly from Gboard to quickly search for the information you need.

patches.name: G Logo on Spacebar
patches.description: Show the G Logo on the spacebar and hide the language label.

patches.name: Grammar Checker
patches.description: Enable Text correction > Grammar check.

patches.name: Hyperspeed Typing Animation
patches.description: Show the animation during sustained fast typing with support for all keyboards.

patches.name: Incognito Mode Toggle
patches.description: Add an Incognito toggle to the Access Point toolbar and configure clipboard and voice typing availability while Incognito mode is active.

patches.name: Inline Suggestions
patches.description: Enable Text correction > Smart Compose.

patches.name: Key Shape Selection
patches.description: Enable Key shape in Theme details.

patches.name: Latin Globe Key Ignore Interval
patches.description: Add an independent English globe key ignore interval override for post-typing language-switch delay.

patches.name: Long-Press Editing Shortcuts
patches.description: Add Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo long-press shortcuts to English QWERTY and Zhuyin.

patches.name: Package Rename
patches.description: Rename the package to com.akshaykadam.pixelboard and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.

patches.name: Quick Insert
patches.description: Enable the Quick Insert panel and toolbar access point.

patches.name: Rounded Keyboard Panel
patches.description: Customize which corners of the keyboard panel are rounded, and set the top and bottom radii separately.

patches.name: Settings Homepage Override
patches.description: Allow switching between the new and legacy Gboard settings pages.

patches.name: Simple Calculator
patches.description: Type an expression and show a scrollable equation plus its answer in Gboard's suggestion row.

patches.name: Swipeable Custom Top Row
patches.description: Swipe the keyboard top row to switch between the stock row and a customizable text/JavaScript row.

patches.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches.description: Customize the Gboard top toolbar item count.

patches.name: Use Bluetooth Microphone
patches.description: Enable Voice typing -> Use Bluetooth microphone.

patches.name: Web Clipboard
patches.description: Add the phone-hosted Web Clipboard with browser sync, pairing, and a Quick Settings Tile.

patches.name: Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes
patches.description: Adjust Zhuyin keyboard bottom-row key sizes.

patches.name: Zhuyin Quick Traditional/Simplified Toggle
patches.description: Swipe up on Zhuyin ㄥ to quickly toggle Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

patches.name: Zhuyin Slide Input
patches.description: Enable slide-up and slide-down input on the Zhuyin keyboard.
